scenes.title: 35mm F0.95 or F1.4?
scenes.say: Brightin Star sells two manual thirty five millimeter lenses for the same price, one eighty nine ninety nine. Which one should you buy?

scenes.title: Ultra-bright for crop cameras
bullets: Fuji X, Sony E, Nikon Z, Canon RF, EOS-M, M43
scenes.say: The F zero point nine five is an APS-C lens. It's ultra bright for night and portraits, with an all metal body, and comes in six mounts including Fuji X and Sony E.

scenes.title: Covers full-frame, made for video
bullets: Sony E, Canon RF, Nikon Z, L-mount, Fuji X
scenes.say: The F one point four covers full frame sensors, weighs two hundred eighteen grams, and has a de clickable aperture ring for smooth video.

scenes.title: Check the fine print
scenes.say: Heads up. Both are manual focus. Order the wrong mount and Brightin Star charges a forty percent restocking fee, and standard shipping takes eighteen to twenty five business days.
